title: Adding a collection and its items
_note: BCP admin recipe add-collection. Three creations in one take: the collection, then its options, then two items. The walk from the dashboard to the store repeats four times, so those lines are deliberately short. Lead-in trimmed 2026-09-09: the first 4s were desktop and a blank browser.

scenes.label: sign-in
scenes.line: This is the sign-in screen. Type the email address for your back-office account, then click Send Code.

scenes.label: enter-the-code
scenes.line: A four-digit code is sent to that address. Type it in. The screen moves on by itself.

scenes.label: dashboard
scenes.line: This is the dashboard. A collection belongs to one store, so we start at Businesses.

scenes.label: find-the-business
scenes.line: Type the name of your business, then pick it from the list.

scenes.label: the-business
scenes.line: This is your business page. Click the lookup icon to see its stores.

scenes.label: find-the-store
scenes.line: Type the store name, then pick it.

scenes.label: the-store
scenes.line: This is the store page. Click the gear, then choose Lookup Collections.

scenes.label: collection-list
scenes.line: This lists the store's collections. Click the plus button to add one.

scenes.label: new-collection
scenes.line: Give the collection a name. This is the group your items will sit in.

scenes.label: collection-details
scenes.line: Add a short description, and the price it starts from. Then save.

scenes.label: back-for-options
scenes.line: Now the options. These are the choices a renter picks between, like a size. We come back to the collection to add them.

scenes.label: find-the-business-2
scenes.line: Same route as before.

scenes.label: the-business-2
scenes.line: Look up the stores.

scenes.label: find-the-store-2
scenes.line: Pick the store.

scenes.label: the-store-2
scenes.line: Gear, then Lookup Collections.

scenes.label: find-the-collection
scenes.line: Open the collection you just made.

scenes.label: set-options
scenes.line: The options field is a list. Each one has a label the renter sees, and the values they can choose. Save when it is done.

scenes.label: back-for-items
scenes.line: Now the items themselves. Each one goes into the collection we just built.

scenes.label: find-the-business-3
scenes.line: Same route again.

scenes.label: the-business-3
scenes.line: Look up the stores.

scenes.label: find-the-store-3
scenes.line: Pick the store.

scenes.label: the-store-3
scenes.line: This time choose Lookup Items.

scenes.label: item-list
scenes.line: Click the plus button to add the first item.

scenes.label: new-item-1
scenes.line: Name the item, then choose the collection it belongs to.

scenes.label: item-details-1
scenes.line: Pick the requirement, pick its option value, then set the price and how many you have.

scenes.label: back-for-item-2
scenes.line: That is the first one. The second is exactly the same journey.

scenes.label: find-the-business-4
scenes.line: Same route.

scenes.label: the-business-4
scenes.line: Look up the stores.

scenes.label: find-the-store-4
scenes.line: Pick the store.

scenes.label: the-store-4
scenes.line: Gear, then Lookup Items.

scenes.label: item-list-2
scenes.line: Plus button again.

scenes.label: new-item-2
scenes.line: Name the second item, and choose the same collection.

scenes.label: item-details-2
scenes.line: Same details, with the other option value. Save.

scenes.label: saved
scenes.line: The collection now has two items in it.

scenes.label: sign-out
scenes.line: To finish, press Control K, type Logout, and press Enter.
